body:
### Summary

I just started using `uv`, and I wanted to migrate my `requirements.txt` files into `pyproject.toml` with it.

```bash
% uv add --dev -r requirements_dev.txt
error: Expected `--hash`, found `"--config-settings=config=Gtk3"` at requirements_dev.txt:2:17
```

I found two sort-of similar issues https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/issues/13834 & https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/issues/4420

This is my `requirements_dev.txt`:

```bash
# Dev package to see types
pygobject-stubs --config-settings=config=Gtk3
```

Now if I change it to this, as splitting into multiple lines was suggested in the linked issues:
```bash
# Dev package to see types
pygobject-stubs
--config-settings config=Gtk3
```

I get this instead:

```bash
% uv add --dev -r requirements_dev.txt
error: Unexpected '-', expected '-c', '-e', '-r' or the start of a requirement at requirements_dev.txt:3:1
```

Am I doing something wrong with the multiline format - in which case what, and why is the format that `pip` supports not valid for `uv`?

Or is what I want just unsupported - in which case the error message could probably be a bit more friendly.

### Platform

Arch Linux

### Version

uv 0.12.1 (329541a50 2026-07-31 x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu)

### Python version

Python 3.14.6
title: `uv add` fails with "Expected `--hash`"
